title.zh: 由 1D 与 2D NMR 推出 C_{8}H_{8}O_{3} 的结构

prompt.zh: CDCl_{3} 中测得 ^{1}H、^{13}C、HMQC、HMBC（500 MHz）。推出结构，说明三个取代基各在哪个位置，并归属每一个峰。
prompt.en: ^{1}H, ^{13}C, HMQC and HMBC in CDCl_{3} (500 MHz). Deduce the structure, place each of the three substituents, and assign every peak.

note.zh: 全部位移和 HMQC、HMBC 相关都取自下面所列来源的实测数据。带 ≈ 的 J 值是文献典型值。
note.en: All shifts and the HMQC and HMBC correlations are measured data from the source listed below. J values marked ≈ are typical literature values.

answer.zh: 答案：4-羟基-3-甲氧基苯甲醛（香草醛）

sources.label: University of Utah, Dept. of Chemistry: vanillin NMR report (500 MHz, CDCl3, 100 mM, TMS)

covers.en: Measured: six ^{1}H shifts (9.83, 7.43, 7.27 solvent, 7.05, 6.29, 3.97), eight ^{13}C shifts (191.0, 151.7, 147.2, 129.9, 127.6, 114.4, 108.7, 56.1) plus the solvent at 77.0; HMQC: the 7.05 proton sits on 114.4, two protons lie at 7.43, and the OH correlates with no carbon; HMBC: 3.97 correlates only with 147.2, 6.29 with 114.4, 147.2 and 151.7, and 9.83 with 108.7 and 129.9. The report gives no J values in Hz and no NOESY.

A second, independent data set used as a cross-check: ^{13}C 191.06, 151.92, 147.22, 129.41, 127.29, 114.46, 108.89, 55.80, all within 0.5 ppm of the values above; it also records a doublet near 7.03 with a spacing of about 9 Hz (field strength not stated).

text.zh: C_{8}H_{8}O_{3} 的不饱和度是 5。只有 8 个碳却有 5 个不饱和度，这个数字本身就在提示结构类型。
text.en: C_{8}H_{8}O_{3} has 5 degrees of unsaturation. Five on only eight carbons is itself a hint about the structure type.

rule.zh: 一个苯环占 4 个不饱和度（3 个 C=C 加 1 个环）。
rule.en: A benzene ring accounts for 4 (three C=C plus one ring).

so.zh: 很可能是一个苯环，再加一个双键或一个环。先当作假设，后面用谱图验证。
so.en: Probably one benzene ring plus one more double bond or ring. Keep it as a hypothesis to test.

text.zh: TMS 之外有 6 组峰：9.83、7.43、7.27、7.05、6.29、3.97。3.97 的峰面积接近其他峰的三倍；7.43 处是两个 H 叠在一起。
text.en: Besides TMS there are 6 signal groups: 9.83, 7.43, 7.27, 7.05, 6.29, 3.97. The 3.97 signal has nearly three times the area of the others, and two H coincide at 7.43.

so.zh: 1 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 3 = 8H 已经够数，7.27 的小峰是多出来的，下一步先处理它。
so.en: 1 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 3 = 8H is already complete, so the small signal at 7.27 is surplus. It is dealt with next.

title.zh: 芳香区里混着一个溶剂峰
title.en: A solvent peak hiding in the aromatic region

ask.zh: δ 7.27 的小单峰正好落在芳香区。它是样品的峰吗？
ask.en: The small singlet at δ 7.27 sits right in the aromatic region. Does it belong to the sample?

text.zh: δ 7.27 是一个面积很小的尖锐单峰，夹在 7.43 和 7.05 之间。
text.en: δ 7.27 is a sharp singlet of small area, sitting between 7.43 and 7.05.

rule.zh: CDCl_{3} 里残余的 CHCl_{3} 出现在 7.26–7.27 ppm。它的面积不成整数比，也和别的峰没有偶合。
rule.en: Residual CHCl_{3} in CDCl_{3} appears at 7.26–7.27 ppm. Its area is not an integer ratio and it couples to nothing.

so.zh: 7.27 是溶剂峰，排除。真正的芳氢只有 7.43（2H）和 7.05（1H），共 3 个。
so.en: 7.27 is the solvent and is excluded. The true aromatic protons are 7.43 (2H) and 7.05 (1H), three in total.

check.zh: 做芳香族化合物时，CDCl_{3} 的残余峰最容易被误算成一个芳氢。
check.en: With aromatic compounds, the residual CDCl_{3} peak is the one most easily miscounted as an aromatic H.

text.zh: δ 3.97 是 3H 单峰。从它入手，因为积分、裂分、位移三样都不含糊。
text.en: δ 3.97 is a 3H singlet. We enter here because integral, multiplicity and shift are all unambiguous.

rule.zh: 单峰说明邻位没有 H；3.7–4.0 ppm 的甲基连在 O 上。
rule.en: A singlet means no neighbouring H. A methyl at 3.7–4.0 ppm sits on oxygen.

check.zh: 它是芳基甲基醚还是甲酯，现在还分不清，等碳谱再判断。
check.en: Aryl methyl ether or methyl ester cannot be told apart yet. The carbon spectrum will decide.

ask.zh: δ 9.83 和 δ 6.29 各 1H，都是单峰。哪个连在碳上，哪个连在氧上？怎么验证？
ask.en: δ 9.83 and δ 6.29 are 1H singlets. Which is on carbon and which on oxygen, and how would you test it?

text.zh: δ 9.83 在很低场；δ 6.29 的位置不属于任何常见的 C–H 类型。
text.en: δ 9.83 lies at very low field. δ 6.29 fits no common C–H type.

rule.zh: 9.5–10 ppm 的单峰是醛基 H。酚羟基在 CDCl_{3} 里常在 5–7 ppm，位置随浓度和温度移动。
rule.en: A singlet at 9.5–10 ppm is an aldehyde H. A phenol OH in CDCl_{3} is often at 5–7 ppm and moves with concentration and temperature.

so.zh: 片段二：–CHO（它就是第 5 个不饱和度）。片段三：–OH，暂定。三个 O 正好用完。
so.en: Fragment 2: –CHO, which is the fifth degree of unsaturation. Fragment 3: –OH, tentatively. All three oxygens are used.

check.zh: OH 只是暂定。HMQC 可以检验：连在氧上的 H 不会与任何碳出现交叉峰。
check.en: The OH is only tentative. HMQC can test it: a proton on oxygen shows no cross peak to any carbon.

title.zh: 芳香区：1D 读不出取代模式
title.en: Aromatic region: 1D cannot give the pattern

text.zh: δ 7.05 是清楚的双峰（1H）。δ 7.43 是 2H，但两个 H 的位移几乎相同，挤成一团，裂分读不出来。
text.en: δ 7.05 is a clean doublet (1H). δ 7.43 is 2H, but the two protons have almost the same shift and merge into one lump whose splitting cannot be read.

rule.zh: 苯环参考值：邻位 ^{3}J ≈ 7–9 Hz，间位 ^{4}J ≈ 1–3 Hz。7.05 的双峰裂距是邻位大小，说明这个 H 恰好有一个邻位 H。
rule.en: Benzene reference values: ortho ^{3}J ≈ 7–9 Hz, meta ^{4}J ≈ 1–3 Hz. The doublet at 7.05 has an ortho-sized spacing, so this H has exactly one ortho H neighbour.

so.zh: 苯环上有 3 个 H 和 3 个取代基，其中至少两个 H 相邻。具体怎么排，这张谱定不了。
so.en: The ring has 3 H and 3 substituents, and at least two H are adjacent. This spectrum cannot fix the exact arrangement.

check.zh: 这里是偶然重叠，不要硬读 7.43 的峰形。J ≈ 8 Hz 是典型值：所引报告只写了"双峰"，第二份数据记录的线距约 9 Hz。
check.en: This is accidental overlap, so do not force a reading of the 7.43 lump. J ≈ 8 Hz is a typical value: the cited report only says doublet, and the second data set records a spacing of about 9 Hz.

title.en: Carbon spectrum: count carbons, read functional groups

text.zh: 除去 δ 77.0 的三重峰（CDCl_{3}，D 的 I = 1，2nI + 1 = 3），正好 8 个碳。191.0 是羰基，151.7 和 147.2 是连 O 的芳碳，56.1 是 OCH_{3}。
text.en: Leaving out the triplet at δ 77.0 (CDCl_{3}; D has I = 1, so 2nI + 1 = 3), there are exactly 8 carbons. 191.0 is a carbonyl, 151.7 and 147.2 are aromatic carbons on oxygen, 56.1 is the OCH_{3}.

rule.zh: 醛、酮羰基在 190 ppm 以上，酯在 165–175。芳基甲基醚的 OCH_{3} 约 55–56，甲酯约 51–52。
rule.en: Aldehyde and ketone C=O appear above 190 ppm, esters at 165–175. An aryl methyl ether OCH_{3} is near 55–56, a methyl ester near 51–52.

so.zh: 191.0 排除了酯，56.1 说明是 Ar–OCH_{3}。8 个碳没有对称性：6 个芳碳各不相同。
so.en: 191.0 rules out an ester and 56.1 means Ar–OCH_{3}. Eight carbons with no symmetry: all six ring carbons differ.

title.zh: HMQC：把叠在一起的两个 H 分开
title.en: HMQC: separating the two overlapping protons

ask.zh: 7.43 那一团在氢谱里分不开。换到碳这一维，会发生什么？
ask.en: The lump at 7.43 cannot be separated in the proton spectrum. What happens along the carbon axis?

text.zh: 7.05 的 H 连在 114.4 上。7.43 这一列出现两个交叉峰，分别对着 127.6 和 108.7。6.29 的 H 没有任何交叉峰。
text.en: The 7.05 proton sits on 114.4. The 7.43 column shows two cross peaks, to 127.6 and to 108.7. The 6.29 proton has no cross peak at all.

rule.zh: HMQC（和 HSQC 一样）只显示直接相连的 H–C。两个 H 的氢位移相同，但它们的碳相差近 20 ppm，在碳维上自然分开。
rule.en: HMQC, like HSQC, shows only directly bonded H–C pairs. The two protons share a proton shift, but their carbons differ by almost 20 ppm and separate along the carbon axis.

so.en: 7.43 really is two different CH groups. Protonated ring carbons: 127.6, 114.4, 108.7. Non-protonated: 151.7, 147.2, 129.9. The 6.29 signal is confirmed as OH.

check.zh: 灰色虚线圈（9.83/191.0 和 3.97/56.1）是按归属预期的相关峰，所引报告的正文没有逐个写出。
check.en: The grey dashed rings (9.83/191.0 and 3.97/56.1) are correlations expected from the assignment. The cited report does not spell them out.

title.zh: 手里的零件，和 10 种拼法
title.en: The parts in hand, and 10 ways to combine them

text.zh: 零件齐了：一个带 3 个 H 的苯环，加上 CHO、OCH_{3}、OH 三个取代基。
text.en: All parts are known: a benzene ring with 3 H, plus the substituents CHO, OCH_{3} and OH.

rule.zh: 带三个不同取代基的苯有 10 种位置异构体。
rule.en: A benzene ring with three different substituents has 10 positional isomers.

so.zh: 1D 谱和 HMQC 都定不了位置。需要 HMBC：它能从取代基上的 H 看到环上的碳。
so.en: Neither the 1D spectra nor HMQC can fix the positions. HMBC is needed: it lets the substituent protons see the ring carbons.

title.en: HMBC: which carbon carries the methoxy group

text.zh: OCH_{3} 的 H（3.97）只与一个碳相关：147.2。
text.en: The OCH_{3} protons (3.97) correlate with one carbon only: 147.2.

rule.zh: 路径 H–C–O–C(芳) 是三根键，这是甲氧基的 H 能到达的唯一环碳。
rule.en: The path H–C–O–C(aryl) is three bonds, and that is the only ring carbon the methoxy protons can reach.

so.zh: 147.2 就是带 OCH_{3} 的碳。于是另一个连 O 的芳碳 151.7 带的是 OH。
so.en: 147.2 is the carbon bearing OCH_{3}. The other oxygenated ring carbon, 151.7, therefore bears the OH.

title.zh: HMBC：让 OH 的氢来定位
title.en: HMBC: let the OH proton do the locating

ask.zh: OH 的 H 通过 2–3 根键能看到哪几个碳？
ask.en: Which carbons can the OH proton see over 2–3 bonds?

text.en: The OH (6.29) correlates with three carbons: 151.7, 147.2 and 114.4.

rule.zh: H–O–C 是两根键（它自己的碳），H–O–C–C 是三根键（两个邻位碳）。所以 OH 看到的正好是本位碳和左右两个邻居。
rule.en: H–O–C is two bonds (its own carbon) and H–O–C–C is three bonds (the two ortho carbons). The OH therefore sees exactly its own carbon and both neighbours.

so.zh: 151.7（C–OH）的两个邻居是 147.2 和 114.4。也就是说：OCH_{3} 和 OH 相邻，OH 的另一侧是带着 7.05 那个 H 的 CH。
so.en: The neighbours of 151.7 (C–OH) are 147.2 and 114.4. So OCH_{3} and OH are adjacent, and on the other side of the OH is the CH that carries the 7.05 proton.

check.zh: OH 的 HMBC 峰不是每次都能看到：交换太快时会消失。这份谱里看到了，是很有用的证据。
check.en: HMBC peaks from an OH are not always visible: fast exchange wipes them out. Here they are seen, and they are valuable evidence.

text.en: The aldehyde H (9.83) correlates with 129.9 and 108.7. 129.9 carries no H, and 108.7 is a CH.

rule.zh: H–C(=O)–C 是两根键，到达醛基所连的环碳；再多一根键到它的邻位碳。
rule.en: H–C(=O)–C is two bonds and reaches the ring carbon bearing the CHO. One more bond reaches the carbons ortho to it.

so.zh: 带 CHO 的环碳是 129.9，它的一个邻位是 108.7 的 CH。最后一个不带 H 的碳也有了着落。
so.en: The ring carbon bearing CHO is 129.9, and one of its neighbours is the CH at 108.7. The last non-protonated carbon is now placed.

title.en: Closing the ring: two candidates left

ask.zh: 环上已有 C-3(OCH_{3})–C-4(OH)–C-5(H)。7.05 的 H-5 是邻位双峰，所以下一个是 CH。剩下 C(CHO) 和一个 CH，有几种接法？
ask.en: The ring so far reads C-3(OCH_{3})–C-4(OH)–C-5(H). H-5 at 7.05 is an ortho doublet, so the next atom is a CH. A C(CHO) and one CH remain. How many ways can they close the ring?

text.zh: 两种。A：C-5H–C-6H–C-1(CHO)–C-2H–C-3，CHO 两侧都是 CH。B：C-5H–CH–CH–C(CHO)–C-3，三个 CH 连成一排，CHO 紧挨着 OCH_{3} 的碳。两者都符合前面所有的 HMBC。
text.en: Two. A: C-5H–C-6H–C-1(CHO)–C-2H–C-3, with CH on both sides of the CHO. B: C-5H–CH–CH–C(CHO)–C-3, three CH in a row with the CHO next to the OCH_{3} carbon. Both fit every HMBC peak so far.

so.zh: 10 种异构体只剩 A 和 B。区别只有一处：CHO 的环碳挨着 OCH_{3} 的碳（B），还是隔着一个 CH（A）。
so.en: Of the 10 isomers only A and B remain. They differ in one place: the CHO carbon is either next to the OCH_{3} carbon (B) or separated from it by a CH (A).

title.zh: 用碳位移在 A 和 B 之间取舍
title.en: Choosing between A and B by carbon shifts

text.zh: 回到碳谱看两个数：OCH_{3} 的碳在 56.1；醛基 H 在 HMBC 里看到的那个 CH 在 108.7，是所有芳碳里最高场的。
text.en: Back to the carbon spectrum for two numbers: the OCH_{3} carbon is at 56.1, and the CH that the aldehyde H sees in HMBC is at 108.7, the most shielded of all ring carbons.

rule.zh: 两条位移规律。其一：芳基 OCH_{3} 两侧都有取代基时，它的碳在 60–62 ppm；至少一侧是 H 时在 55–56 ppm。其二：芳环 CH 要屏蔽到 110 ppm 以下，通常要紧挨着一个连 O 的碳。
rule.en: Two shift rules. First: an aryl OCH_{3} flanked by substituents on both sides has its carbon at 60–62 ppm; with an H on at least one side it is at 55–56 ppm. Second: an aromatic CH shielded below 110 ppm normally sits next to an oxygen-bearing carbon.

so.zh: OCH_{3} 在 56.1：它旁边必须有一个 CH，B 排除。108.7 的 CH 夹在 C-1 和 C-3 之间，正是 A 里的 C-2。结构是 A。
so.en: The OCH_{3} is at 56.1, so it must have a CH beside it, and B is ruled out. The CH at 108.7 lies between C-1 and C-3, which is C-2 in A. The structure is A.

check.zh: 这一步用的是位移规律，属于"指向"而不是直接证明。直接的证明是 NOE：OCH_{3} 应当与 H-2 相关。所引数据里没有 NOESY，所以这里不画。
check.en: This step uses shift rules, so it points to A but is not a direct proof. The direct proof would be an NOE from OCH_{3} to H-2. The cited data contain no NOESY, so none is drawn here.

text.zh: 核对：C_{8}H_{8}O_{3} 的原子全部用上；5 个不饱和度 = 苯环 4 + C=O 1；5 组样品的氢信号（8H）和 8 个碳全部归属，溶剂峰已说明。6 个实测 HMBC 相关在结构上都是 2 或 3 根键。
text.en: Check: every atom of C_{8}H_{8}O_{3} is used; 5 degrees of unsaturation = 4 for the ring + 1 for C=O; all 5 sample proton signals (8H) and 8 carbons are assigned, and the solvent is accounted for. All six measured HMBC correlations span 2 or 3 bonds in the structure.

so.zh: 结构确定：4-羟基-3-甲氧基苯甲醛，也就是香草醛。
so.en: The structure is settled: 4-hydroxy-3-methoxybenzaldehyde, better known as vanillin.

check.zh: 想把 H-2 和 H-6 分开看，可以换溶剂（例如 DMSO-d_{6}）重测。
check.en: To see H-2 and H-6 separately, the sample can be re-measured in another solvent such as DMSO-d_{6}.
